mechanisms.name: towntrip state machine (main.go:5550-5708, phases 0-5)
mechanisms.how: Hand-rolled switch on tpPhase: cast TP at feet -> hover/interact-click the nearest portal -> errands in town -> return through same portal, with walk-fallback phases 4/5 for TP-banned areas (curGoto pinned every tick against autoprogress resets). Verification is observed area change; 5s heartbeat added after the 48-minute silent hang.
mechanisms.verdict: PARTIAL. Area-change verification and heartbeat are sound. But phase 2's happy path is UNBOUNDED: when a portal IS visible, the click-sleep loop consults no timeout at all (the 5s/10s clocks live only in the no-portal else-branches, main.go:5587-5606) — the 48-min hang mechanism is still live; the heartbeat made it visible, not cured. Phases 4/5 couple to the route machinery through the shared mutable curGoto global.

mechanisms.name: vendorErrand: Akara approach + open (main.go:4866-4976)
mechanisms.how: Walk to hardcoded anchor (5530,4690) until NPC 148 loads, body-click at 6 guessed pixel offsets with a step-away/re-approach dance between attempts, poll UIBytes[0xF4]==1 for menu-open, then VK_DOWN keyhold (GetKeyState override + raw down/up) + Enter, confirm shop by pixel-diff bigLeftChange>12000.
mechanisms.verdict: MIXED. UIBytes[0xF4] menu byte: PROVEN (found by diffing user-produced open/closed snapshots; polled, 1.2s miss detection). Keyhold Down+Enter nav: PROVEN once (user-verified). Body-click offsets, fresh-approach dance, anchor coordinate, and the 12000 pixel threshold: SUPERSTITION — single-seed, single-success folklore with no hover confirmation on the NPC body.

mechanisms.name: vendorErrand: sell pass (main.go:4982-5014)
mechanisms.how: For Normal identified items not on a name denylist (Jawbone/Eye/Scalp/Topaz/Tome/Charm...), uiClick the backpack cell to pick, uiClick(480,500) to drop into vendor grid, verify by item no longer at origin position+name.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN clicks, BROKEN verification. Left panel clicks demonstrably work (items leave). But 'origin cell empty' == success also holds when the drop MISSED and the item rides the cursor — counted SOLD, and a stuck cursor eats every later click (the 'axe lesson' the code itself cites). Only autoequip checks LocationCursor (main.go:6525); this pass does not.

mechanisms.name: vendorErrand: left-click buy experiment (main.go:5015-5050)
mechanisms.how: uiClick(178,240) on the TP-tome slot measured from one akara_shop.png, then uiClick a free backpack cell; logs inventory count before/after.
mechanisms.verdict: UNPROVEN. Explicitly an experiment: coordinate from a single screenshot, outcome only logged (never acted on), never confirmed to have purchased anything. The panel RIGHT-click buy is a PROVEN NEGATIVE (deaf under every override tried — step verbs rui/ruii, main.go:3053-3065, 5138-5148).

mechanisms.name: identifyErrand (main.go:3073-3133)
mechanisms.how: The deaf-right-click pivot: -idkey (F4) selects the tome's granted Book of Identify skill, a WORLD right-click at (cx/2,cy) raises the ID cursor, then a panel LEFT uiClick on each unidentified cell; per-item verification = Identified flag must flip in memory; capped at 12/visit.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN, and the best-designed errand: skill-presence precondition, per-item closed loop, tome inventory position made irrelevant (immune to the mod's tome renaming). The template the redesign should generalize.

mechanisms.name: cubeStash (main.go:3139-3236)
mechanisms.how: Direct cube keybind ('h') sidesteps the deaf panel right-click; keeper filter (Magic+ quality minus a name denylist) pick+place from backpack into the mod's expanded 12x8 cube via uiClick pairs; verify by origin cell empty; on failure click origin to put back and abort pass.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN mechanics, INCOMPLETE verification: same cursor hole as the sell pass — pick-succeeded/place-missed leaves the item on the cursor, origin is empty, counted 'stashed', pass continues with a poisoned cursor. Also shadows every item as 2x3 (conservative but wasteful) and hardcodes cell pixels from one 2026-07-18 calibration.

mechanisms.name: corpse recovery (main.go:6581-6769 + death-state file)
mechanisms.how: Remembered corpseTargetPos (Found trusted as 'gone' only at dist<=10 with 8-tick streak), don't-feed-the-camp pack assessment on approach, town-road force-holds when parked, field last-mile fresh-edge strides, resumable 13x7 hover sweep (14 probes/tick), double-confirmed Corpse.IsHovered then interactClick, verify by Corpse.Found flipping; blind interactClick after 3 failed sweeps; 3-min timebox + 10-min cooldown.
mechanisms.verdict: PARTIAL. Position memory, gone-streak, pack gate, resumable sweep: PROVEN good design. The CLICK ITSELF is the deaf-click class: overnight_20.log 20:46:41-54 shows TEN double-hover-confirmed clicks at constant dist=6 with Found never flipping, then death — the click registers, but the game-internal walk it delegates (pond/fence-blocked) fails invisibly, and no code observes whether the character started moving after the click. Blind-click fallback: SUPERSTITION.

mechanisms.name: autoequip (main.go:6458-6545)
mechanisms.how: Gated on calm + tpPhase==0 + 45s cooldown; candidate chosen against the MOD's own item tables (internal/gear) for empty armor/jewelry slots only; open inventory, uiClick pick, uiClick measured paperdoll pixel; verify by equipped list AND LocationCursor; stuck cursor -> put item back, disable feature for the run.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN and the ONLY interaction with a complete contract: effect check + anomaly check + rollback + self-disable. This is what 'an interaction verb that verifies its own effect' looks like; nothing else in the file matches it.

mechanisms.name: stash (town stash object)
mechanisms.how: Does not exist. Only -npcprobe reports OpenMenus.Stash (and OpenMenus is a documented liar on this build). No stash open, deposit, or object-identity code anywhere; the 12x8 cube is the de facto stash.
mechanisms.verdict: UNBUILT. Object identity unknown; correctly deferred — the cube workaround is strictly better today (travels with the character).

mechanisms.name: waypoint activation (objects block, main.go:7727-7756)
mechanisms.how: On sight within objradius, walk to pad, hoverPickClick(o.Position, o.ID), sleep 900ms, blind ESC to close the panel; wpTouched[o.ID] one-shot.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN activation (WPs hover-click fine, -wpat verified; ESC safe because a panel IS open). Two holes: no o.ID!=0 filter (every probe has it — the statics-id=0 law, main.go:3794 vs 7734), and 'panel opened' is assumed, never observed, before the ESC.

mechanisms.name: waypoint travel (-wpgoto probe, main.go:3745-3865)
mechanisms.how: Measured area->row table (2 rows MEASURED by -wpcal blue-compass litRow + round-trip travel, 2 ASSUMED from vanilla order, provenance honestly annotated), clickY=178+41*row in the same row-space panelLitRow scans, uiClick, verify by area change with three-way failure diagnosis (panel open+lit / open+unlit / gone).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN for the two measured rows; NOT INTEGRATED — travel exists only as a CLI probe, the main loop never uses waypoints to move. The measured-provenance discipline here (never promote vanilla assumptions) is exemplary.

mechanisms.name: uiClick / uiRightClick panel primitives (main.go:689-740, 3053-3065)
mechanisms.how: aimPanel patches GetPhysicalCursorPos (or GetCursorInfo) to raw physical pixels = scaled window origin + UNSCALED client offset (measured 2026-07-17), async WM hover, VK-button GetKeyState override across the click window, client-lParam click, restore.
mechanisms.verdict: uiClick LEFT: PROVEN across skill tree, char panel, WP rows, inventory, cube. uiRightClick: PROVEN DEAF (a negative law worth keeping). Returns void — effect verification is every caller's private problem.

mechanisms.name: interactClick world left-click (main.go:671-680)
mechanisms.how: moveStop, AimPhysical, VK_LBUTTON GetKeyState/GetAsyncKeyState override, hid.Click, restore.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN to make D2R register the click (portals, corpse-hover clicks all land). But its EFFECT is a delegated walk-then-act the game may silently abandon — the primitive returns nothing and observes nothing, so it cannot distinguish deaf click / blocked walk / wrong target.

mechanisms.name: hoverPickClick universal world interactor (main.go:779-830)
mechanisms.how: 13x7 cursor sweep above the sprite until HoverData.UnitID matches, DOUBLE-CONFIRM by re-aiming the exact point (beats frame latency), LeftClickNoMove without re-moving the pointer, then — for ground items only — wait up to 1.4s for the item to leave LocationGround.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN as hover-confirmation (the honest 'will this click hit'). But returns true on click for every non-item kind (waypoints, chests, portals) with zero effect verification — 'true' means 'I clicked while hovered', not 'it worked'.

mechanisms.name: interactNPC (main.go:838-884)
mechanisms.how: Sweep NPC body, require HoverData.UnitType==5 double-confirmed, log (not require) hoverID==Monster.UnitID, click, sleep 700ms.
mechanisms.verdict: PARTIAL/UNUSED (assigned to _). Hover-on-NPC proven via -hovergrid; the id-match question is honestly logged-not-assumed; vendorErrand bypasses it entirely for blind body-offset clicks.

mechanisms.name: castSelf / world right-click (main.go:519-528)
mechanisms.how: moveStop, press skill key, 120ms, right-click at screen center.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN transport (every golem/summon cast, the ID-cursor raise). Zero self-verification — summon success is verified elsewhere by pet count; a failed self-cast is invisible at the verb.

mechanisms.name: panel/menu detectors (four private sensors)
mechanisms.how: UIBytes[0xF4] (vendor menu byte); panelLitRow blue-compass blueness>25 (WP panel, main.go:746-766); bigLeftChange>12000 pixel diff (shop, main.go:4848-4861); findNpcMenu gold-border cluster with border test (main.go:3243+).
mechanisms.verdict: Individually measured, collectively an indictment: OpenMenus is a known liar, so every service grew its own unshared pixel/byte heuristic, none verifying panel CLOSE, each with its own ESC folklore around the pause-menu trap.

rootDefects.defect: No uniform interaction contract: every verb (uiClick, interactClick, hoverPickClick, castSelf, key nav) is fire-and-forget, returning void or a click-happened boolean; the postcondition is invented (or omitted, or wrong) independently at every call site.
rootDefects.evidence: hoverPickClick verifies effect only for ground items (main.go:812-825), returns bare true for waypoints/chests/portals; the objects block logs 'interacted' and sleeps 250ms with no check (7781-7784); cubeStash and vendor-sell count a stuck-cursor as success (origin-cell-empty predicate, 3208-3214, 4999-5013) while autoequip alone checks LocationCursor with rollback (6525-6537); corpse, towntrip, and wpGoto each wrap the same interactClick in three different hand-built effect polls (Corpse.Found, area change, area+blueness+screenshots).
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: Correctness of every service depends on each call site independently rediscovering the same verify/rollback/disable pattern; the one complete implementation (autoequip) was never generalized, so every new errand re-fights the same failure classes. A redesign needs interaction verbs that carry their own precondition (hover/panel-state), postcondition (observed effect), timebox, and failure taxonomy — 'silence is never success' enforced by the type, not by discipline.

rootDefects.defect: The click-delegated-walk blind spot (the deaf-click class): clicking a corpse/item/portal is not an action but a REQUEST for the game to path there and act; that internal walk can fail against collision invisible to every data source (mod town fences, ponds), and no primitive observes whether the character started moving after the click.
rootDefects.evidence: overnight_20.log 20:46:41-54: TEN double-hover-confirmed corpse clicks at constant dist=6, Corpse.Found never flips, character then dies on the spot; the measured laws that the mod's town fences exist in no collision source and id=0 statics ignore all synthetic clicks; commit ec627a8's air-punch fix addressed the same disease for combat strikes only.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The interaction model assumes click==effect, but D2R's model is click==intent-to-walk-then-act. Without a post-click motion/progress observer on the induced journey, the bot cannot distinguish a deaf click, a blocked walk, and a wrong target — three failures with three different cures (re-click / reposition-and-retry / re-acquire). Hover confirmation solved 'will this click HIT'; nothing solves 'did this click WORK'. Every world interaction in the redesign must be a monitored journey (click -> expect motion -> expect arrival -> expect state change), reusing the progress-clock machinery movement already has.

rootDefects.defect: No single authority for UI/panel state: OpenMenus is documented garbage on this build, and instead of one panel-state oracle, four private detectors and per-site ESC folklore grew inside individual errands.
rootDefects.evidence: UIBytes[0xF4] used only by vendorErrand (4937); panelLitRow blueness only by WP code (746); bigLeftChange only by the shop-open check (4848); findNpcMenu gold-border only by the dialog prober (3243); waypoint activation ESCs a panel it never confirmed opened (7747); the pause-menu ESC trap is re-documented at every site instead of being encoded once.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: Panel state is cross-cutting perception, not errand logic. Its absence makes every service embed pixel heuristics and single-machine constants, makes panel CLOSE unverifiable (a wedged-open panel silently eats all subsequent world input), and makes errands non-composable. The redesign needs one UI-state oracle (menu byte + pixel sensors as corroborating witnesses) that every verb consults before and after acting.

rootDefects.defect: Services are blocking monoliths as closures inside one ~8000-line main(), coupled through shared mutable globals; the towntrip 'state machine' is really distributed state (tpPhase, tpWalkBack, curGoto, tpErrandsDone) that other blocks must know to interlock with.
rootDefects.evidence: vendorErrand runs an 80x150ms navigation loop plus a 6-attempt step-away/re-approach dance with survival checks suspended (4872-4919); phases 4/5 must pin curGoto EVERY TICK because goto-failure paths reset it and autoprogress then re-asserts the farm route (5662-5691, a bug that 'cost a night'); phase 2's portal-visible path has no timeout (5587-5592) — the 48-minute silent hang, cured only cosmetically by a heartbeat (commit 41f888b); the resumable corpse sweep (6702-6714) is a one-off fix for exactly this blocking disease.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: There is no scheduler-visible unit of 'errand with budget, preconditions, and abort semantics' — each errand steals the whole loop for seconds to minutes, and each new behavior must learn the interlocks of all existing ones. The 80ms tick floor, the claim() arbiter, and the errands all fight over one thread of control; town services need to be first-class tasks under the same arbitration as combat/loot, not inline subroutines.

rootDefects.defect: Item identity is remapped-name folklore scattered across at least four independent, inconsistent denylists instead of one identity oracle — despite internal/gear already parsing the mod's own excel tables.
rootDefects.evidence: deriveCombat ranged detection by name substring (556); cubeStash keeper excludes Jawbone/Eye/Scalp but not Topaz (3156-3158); vendor sell excludes Topaz/Flag additionally (4989-4993); autoequip has its own smaller list (6491). The mod renames tomes to ''/Jawbone/Eye and the cube to Topaz — one missed name in one list sells the ID tome or cubes the cube.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The mod-remapping problem is solved once in internal/gear (which reads D2RMM's actual data tables) but the interaction layer never consumes it; every service re-encodes partial folk knowledge. Classification (is-tome, is-cube, is-sellable, is-wearable) must be one oracle keyed on item codes from the mod's tables, not four string lists keyed on lying display names.

rootDefects.defect: Progress clocks and timeboxes are bolted on per-site, one post-mortem at a time, instead of being intrinsic to any journey or interaction.
rootDefects.evidence: Commit trail: armloot got its timeout (cb80699), then critloot (8cdca68, whose message states the general law: 'every journey that walks at a target needs a progress clock; the ones without one WILL find an unreachable target'), then corpse field-last-mile (ec627a8) — yet towntrip phase 2's happy path and the vendor approach loop still have none.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The codebase has already discovered the invariant and cannot enforce it, because there is no journey/interaction abstraction to attach it to — only interleaved if-blocks. In the redesign the progress clock is a field of the verb, not a patch on the caller.

keep: Hover confirmation via HoverData.UnitID with the double-confirm re-aim (beats frame latency) as the only honest 'will this click hit' — and Corpse.IsHovered as its corpse-specific twin
VK-state override law: D2R polls GetKeyState/GetAsyncKeyState, so every synthetic click/keypress must hold the override across the input window (clicks, menu VK_DOWN nav, force-move key)
The two measured coordinate spaces: panel clicks = raw physical pixels (scaled origin + unscaled client offset), world aim = client x dpiscale — never unified, both measured

The deaf-panel-right-click pivot: identify via the tome's granted skill (F4 select, world right-click raises ID cursor, panel LEFT-click the item) — world right-clicks work, panel right-clicks never will
identifyErrand's per-item closed loop (Identified flag must flip) as the effect-verification pattern for inventory operations
autoequip's complete interaction contract — effect check + LocationCursor anomaly check + rollback + self-disable-on-anomaly — as the template for EVERY verb in the redesign
UIBytes[0xF4] menu byte as a real memory-truth panel signal (and the diff-snapshots method that found it) — seed for the single UI-state oracle
Cube-as-portable-stash: the mod's 12x8 cube via direct keybind beats building town-stash interaction at all
panelLitRow's provenance discipline: area->row entries only from measured -wpcal readings, assumptions annotated and never promoted — extend to every calibrated constant
Corpse epistemics: remembered position as truth, live Corpse.Found trusted as 'gone' only within loaded-room range with a consistency streak; death-state file surviving restarts
Don't-feed-the-camp: pack-assessment gating on recovery approach (measure the actual danger, not proxy rules from old deaths)
Phase heartbeat ('silence is never health') — but promoted from a towntrip patch to a property of every long-running task
ESC-only-when-a-panel-is-confirmed-open law (the pause-menu trap), and toggling panels with their own keys
The measured-negative catalog itself: panel right-clicks deaf, id=0 statics deaf, synthetic move-clicks refuted, OpenMenus garbage — negatives are laws, not gaps
Waypoint activation on sight, and the wpGoto verification style (area change + panel-state + screenshot triage of the three failure shapes)
discard: All fire-and-forget verbs as they stand: void-returning uiClick/interactClick/castSelf and hoverPickClick's unconditional true for non-items — replace with verbs that own precondition, postcondition, timebox, and failure taxonomy

The click==effect assumption for world interactions — every click that delegates a walk to the game must become a monitored journey with a motion observer and strategy escalation (the ten deaf corpse clicks are the proof it cannot survive)
Blind-click fallbacks (corpse blind interactClick after 3 sweep failures) — an unverifiable verb fired at a guess is superstition by construction
The hand-rolled towntrip phase switch with its curGoto pinning interlock and the unbounded phase-2 portal-click loop — town trips become a scheduled task with per-phase budgets enforced structurally

vendorErrand's inline blocking navigation dances (80-iteration walk loops, 6-attempt body-click offset guessing without NPC hover confirmation) — approach belongs to the movement layer, NPC targeting to hover confirmation
'Origin cell empty' as pick+place success (cubeStash, vendor sell) — a stuck cursor counted as success poisons every subsequent click; LocationCursor check + rollback is mandatory
The four scattered mod-name denylists (Jawbone/Eye/Scalp/Topaz/'' folklore) — replaced by one item-identity oracle built on internal/gear's parse of the mod's own tables

Per-errand private panel detectors as primary evidence (bigLeftChange>12000, gold-border clustering) — demoted to corroborating sensors behind one UI-state authority; a panel state that cannot be read cannot anchor an errand
The unproven left-click buy as anything but an experiment — no purchase flow ships without a verified item-arrived postcondition and a gold-delta check
Vanilla-order assumptions in the WP row table (rows for areas 48/43) and any constant not re-measured on this machine/seed
The 'never worked' town-stash ambition for now — the cube covers it; stash interaction earns a slot only after object identity is probed

Retry-the-same-verb-harder loops everywhere (portal click x infinity, body-click offset cycling) — a failed verified attempt must change STRATEGY (reposition, re-acquire, abandon), the culture rule the codebase states but cannot enforce inline
